import json,sys,bisect,ipaddress as ip,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
import test_dp as D, validate
from reference import reference_runs
from audit import LANES
payload = open('/tmp/dpcase.json').read()
out=json.loads(subprocess.run(['python3','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=payload.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout.decode())
res=out['cases'][0]
req=validate.parse_request(payload.encode())[0]
fib={}
for route,hop in req['initial']: fib[route]=hop
fibs=[dict(fib)]
for tx in req['transactions']:
    for op,route,hop in tx:
        if op=='set': fib[route]=hop
        elif route in fib: del fib[route]
    fibs.append(dict(fib))
hit,miss,dec=req['costs']
C=req['cache_pages']
tot_work=0;tot_pages=0
for vi,(v,ver) in enumerate(zip(fibs,res['versions'])):
    starts,hops=reference_runs(v)
    bl=[(rep,[bisect.bisect_right(starts,int(ip.IPv6Address(a)))-1 for a in addrs]) for vv,rep,addrs in req['bursts'] if vv==vi]
    fr=D.version_frontier(starts,bl,C,hit,miss,dec)
    # actual from image
    nodes,size=validate.decode_image(ver['image'],starts,hops)
    resident=sum(n['pages'] for n in nodes.values() if n['cached'])
    work=0
    for vv,rep,addrs in req['bursts']:
        if vv!=vi: continue
        visits={};touched=set()
        for a in addrs:
            ai=int(ip.IPv6Address(a))
            rn,path=validate.walk(nodes,ai)
            for o in path: visits[o]=visits.get(o,0)+1
            touched.update(path)
        for o in touched:
            n=nodes[o];k=len(n['keys'])
            work+=rep*(n['pages']*(hit if n['cached'] else miss)+((k+LANES[n['mode']]-1)//LANES[n['mode']]+dec[n['mode']])*visits[o])
    print('v',vi,'R',len(starts),'actual work',work,'pages',size,'resident',resident)
    fr.sort()
    print('   python frontier:',fr)
    tot_work+=work; tot_pages+=size
print('total',tot_work,tot_pages,'reported',res['objective'])
PYEOF
